_meta.note: ADL-MIDAS = OLS of y_t on [1, y_{t-1..t-P}, hf_lags[t, :]] over t = P..n-1; design built with pandas.shift, fitted with statsmodels OLS: nonrobust, and HAC (Bartlett, use_correction=True) at the default maxlags floor(4((n-P)/100)^(2/9)) and at maxlags=8. hf_lags column 1 is high-frequency lag 0 (the period's last observation). level_cases: persistent level targets with an exact rational least-squares reference (exact) and statsmodels' distance from it (sm_vs_exact).
